scope: Pinned Mupen64Plus-Next Android ARM64 GLES3 build using the AArch64 dynarec, GLideN64, Mupen64Plus core, RSP-HLE, the exact vendored support sources selected by Makefile.common, and the Android NDK r27 libc++ static runtime. paraLLEl RDP/RSP, Angrylion, CXD4, private Android GraphicBuffer APIs, the process-wide libc++_shared runtime, fonts, game content, and firmware are excluded.
conclusion: Configuration-specific compatible candidate. Selected program sources state GPL-2.0-or-later and are exercised under GPLv3 for EmuFusion's source-available aggregate. Selected permissive/LGPL dependencies and the Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception static C++ runtime are compatible with that election; all notices and corresponding source remain required.
